label: run83 chp startup
definition: Run 83: CHP startup exemption probe (chp_startup_covered - CC_CHP/CT_CHP/ST_CHP pay no P1 startup-amortization markup; steam host covers starts). Result: identical to run79 in every class-year - a true no-op, because only the committed tranche carries startup cost and CHP committed tranches run continuously on their must-run floors (amortization was already ~zero). Rules OUT startup cost as the cause of the CT_CHP top-band miss (CAMPD 25% of hours above 0.8 CF vs model 1.7%, BTM-aware panel); that miss is the band economics (econ_high 1.30/peak 1.32 on high CT heat rates) and/or tranche shares. Keeper remains the run79 config.
